title: Automorphism-Induced Entanglement Bounds in Many-Body Systems
summary: We derive an upper bound on the maximum balanced bipartite entanglement entropy of ground states of many-body Hamiltonians defined on a graph, agnostic to any particular model, that possesses a nontrivial automorphism group. We show that the entropy is bounded by the logarithm of a weighted sum of multiplicities of irreducible representations of the bipartition-preserving automorphism subgroup.
